Date: Tue Apr 28 20:27:00 CEST 2026
Subject: [libcamera-devel] libcamera v0.7.1 released

libcamera v0.7.1 has been released.
This release updates SoftISP behavior, image pipeline handling, and sensor configuration.
It also improves V4L2 camera pipeline validation for media controller devices.
The Mali-C55 pipeline handler now has full support for inline handling and camera support.
The software_isp DebayerParams fix closes https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/camera/libcamera/-/issues/311.
The gstreamer sensor-config property closes https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/camera/libcamera/-/issues/300.
